blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解 PDA PtC-1 的歷史沿革（2003 → 2015/16 → 2023），以及 2022 EU Annex 1 如何觸發本次修訂
blocks.en: Understand the history of PDA PtC-1 (2003 → 2015/16 → 2023) and how the 2022 EU Annex 1 triggered this revision

blocks.zh: 掌握指導本文件的五大原則，並能解釋每一原則對 CDMO 日常決策的實務意涵
blocks.en: Master the five guiding principles of the document and be able to explain what each means for day-to-day CDMO decisions

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Glossary 中每個術語的精確定義，辨別易混淆的相似詞（如 At-Rest vs. In-Operations，Action Limit vs. Alert Limit）
blocks.en: Know the precise definition of every Glossary term and distinguish look-alike terms (e.g., At-Rest vs. In-Operations, Action Limit vs. Alert Limit)

blocks.zh: 建立「無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 優先於一切」的決策階層思維框架
blocks.en: Build a decision-hierarchy mindset in which "Sterility Assurance comes before everything else"

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — PDA PtC-1 是什麼？為什麼重要？
blocks.en: Core Concepts — What Is PDA PtC-1, and Why Does It Matter?

blocks.zh: Points to Consider (PtC，考量要點) 是 PDA 出版的一種特殊文件類型，介於技術報告（Technical Report）與法規指引之間。它不具法規約束力，但代表業界最佳智識共識，常被 FDA 與 EMA 稽查員引用作為期望水準的參考依據。
blocks.en: Points to Consider (PtC) is a special type of document published by PDA, sitting between a Technical Report and a regulatory guideline. It is not legally binding, but it represents the best-practice consensus of industry and is often cited by FDA and EMA inspectors as a reference for expected standards.

blocks.zh: PtC-1 專注於無菌加工 (Aseptic Processing)，是整個 PDA 文獻體系中關於無菌環境管控、人員、APS 模擬、BFS 技術、清潔消毒的最權威單一文件。對 CDMO 而言，這份文件等同於「客戶稽核的教科書」。
blocks.en: PtC-1 focuses on Aseptic Processing and is the most authoritative single document in the PDA literature on aseptic environmental control, personnel, APS simulation, BFS technology, and cleaning and disinfection. For a CDMO, this document is effectively "the textbook for customer audits".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 文件版本演進的比喻
blocks.en: Analogy — The Evolution of the Document

blocks.zh: 想像 PtC-1 是一本「廚房衛生操作手冊」：
blocks.en: Imagine PtC-1 is a "kitchen hygiene handbook":

blocks.zh: 2003 年版：基礎版，教你洗手與刀具消毒
blocks.en: 2003 edition: the basic version, teaching hand washing and knife disinfection

blocks.zh: 2015/2016 年版：加入新式不鏽鋼廚具與空氣過濾設備的指引，分上下冊
blocks.en: 2015/2016 edition: added guidance on new stainless steel cookware and air filtration equipment, published in two parts

blocks.zh: 2023 年版（本版）：合併上下冊，並全面對齊 2022 年發布的「全球最嚴格廚房衛生法規」（EU Annex 1）——不只更新設備章節，連人員資格、消毒劑輪換等細節全部重寫
blocks.en: 2023 edition (this version): merges the two parts and aligns fully with the "strictest kitchen hygiene regulation in the world" issued in 2022 (EU Annex 1). It does not just update the equipment chapters; details such as personnel qualification and disinfectant rotation have all been rewritten.

blocks.zh: 重點：舊版（2015/16）已被本版完全取代。如果你的 SOP 還引用 2015 年 PtC-1，現在必須更新。
blocks.en: Key point: the earlier edition (2015/16) has been completely superseded by this version. If your SOPs still cite the 2015 PtC-1, they must now be updated.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 2022 EU Annex 1 的衝擊
blocks.en: Key Point — The Impact of the 2022 EU Annex 1

blocks.zh: 2022 年 8 月，歐盟發布重新修訂的 GMP Annex 1，全長 58 頁（前版僅 16 頁），新增大量要求：
blocks.en: In August 2022 the EU published the revised GMP Annex 1. At 58 pages (the previous version had only 16), it adds many new requirements:

blocks.zh: 強制要求 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS，污染控制策略) 作為系統性文件
blocks.en: Requires a Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) as a systematic, documented element

blocks.zh: Isolator 與 RABS 明確區分，並提升 RABS 要求等級
blocks.en: Clearly distinguishes Isolators from RABS and raises the requirements for RABS

blocks.zh: BFS 技術納入 "modern technology" 框架
blocks.en: Brings BFS technology into the "modern technology" framework

blocks.zh: APS 媒體填充要求更嚴格
blocks.en: Stricter requirements for APS (media fill)

blocks.zh: 正因 Annex 1 如此重大，PDA 才緊急於 2023 年更新 PtC-1，確保兩者技術立場相符。每當 Annex 1 與 PtC-1 有分歧，本文件會明確標注——這個設計對 CDMO 特別寶貴，因為你的客戶可能同時受 FDA 與 EMA 管轄。
blocks.en: Because Annex 1 is so significant, PDA urgently updated PtC-1 in 2023 to ensure the two documents take consistent technical positions. Wherever Annex 1 and PtC-1 diverge, this document says so explicitly. This is especially valuable for a CDMO, because your customers may fall under both FDA and EMA jurisdiction.

blocks.zh: 五大原則解析（CDMO 視角）
blocks.en: The Five Principles Explained (CDMO Perspective)

blocks.zh: 原則 1 — 科學/風險導向：不能只依賴「傳統做法就這樣」，每個決策（環境監控頻率、APS 挑戰數量）都要有科學根據與風險評估支撐。對 CDMO：當客戶要求比 GMP 更嚴的標準時，用風險評估說明你現有標準已足夠或確實需要提升。
blocks.en: Principle 1 — Science- and risk-based approach: You cannot rely on "that's how it has always been done". Every decision (environmental monitoring frequency, number of APS challenges) must be supported by scientific rationale and risk assessment. For a CDMO: when a customer asks for a standard stricter than GMP, use risk assessment to show either that your current standard is already sufficient or that it really does need to be raised.

blocks.zh: 原則 2 — 採用新技術：法規鼓勵使用 Isolator、RABS、一次性系統等新技術，不應因「稽查官不熟悉」而保守。CDMO 的競爭優勢之一就是率先導入新技術。
blocks.en: Principle 2 — Adopting new technology: Regulators encourage the use of new technologies such as Isolators, RABS, and single-use systems. Do not be conservative simply because "the inspector is unfamiliar with it". Being first to adopt new technology is one of a CDMO's competitive advantages.

blocks.zh: 原則 3 — 重新評估傳統方法：某些傳統測試（如固定頻率的手動 settle plates）可能已過時，應以更科學的方式取代。這是本版最具突破性的立場之一。
blocks.en: Principle 3 — Re-evaluating traditional methods: Some traditional tests (such as manual settle plates at a fixed frequency) may be outdated and should be replaced by more scientific approaches. This is one of the most groundbreaking positions in this edition.

blocks.zh: 原則 4 — 新療法/新技術的挑戰：mRNA 疫苗、CAR-T 細胞治療等新型態產品，無法套用傳統無菌加工框架，必須重新設計管控策略。
blocks.en: Principle 4 — Challenges of novel therapies and technologies: New product types such as mRNA vaccines and CAR-T cell therapies cannot be fitted into the traditional aseptic processing framework, and the control strategy must be redesigned.

blocks.zh: 原則 5 — 全球法規一致性：FDA、EMA、PIC/S 技術語言的統一，減少 CDMO 在多地區申請時重複努力。
blocks.en: Principle 5 — Global regulatory alignment: Harmonizing the technical language of FDA, EMA, and PIC/S reduces duplicated effort for a CDMO filing in multiple regions.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 的 PtC-1 使用場景
blocks.en: Practical Application — How a CDMO Uses PtC-1

blocks.zh:
場景 1：客戶稽核準備
客戶品保問："你們的環境監測計畫依據哪份指引？"
回答："依據 FDA Aseptic Guidance (2004)、EU Annex 1 (2022) 及 PDA PtC-1 (2023 修訂版)，三者相互對照，差異處均有書面說明。"
blocks.en:
Scenario 1: Preparing for a customer audit
Customer QA asks: "Which guidance is your environmental monitoring program based on?"
Answer: "It is based on the FDA Aseptic Guidance (2004), EU Annex 1 (2022), and PDA PtC-1 (2023 revision). The three have been cross-compared, and every difference is documented."

blocks.zh:
場景 2：SOP 審查
稽核員發現你的 SOP 引用 "PDA PtC for Aseptic Processing (2016)"——應立即更新為 2023 年版，並說明兩版差異評估已完成。
blocks.en:
Scenario 2: SOP review
An auditor finds that your SOP cites "PDA PtC for Aseptic Processing (2016)". Update it to the 2023 edition immediately and document that the assessment of differences between the two editions has been completed.

blocks.zh:
場景 3：技術評估新技術
評估是否導入 Isolator 時，引用原則 2 作為技術決策依據，並透過 QRM 評估風險降低的程度，向客戶展示投資價值。
blocks.en:
Scenario 3: Technical evaluation of new technology
When evaluating whether to adopt an Isolator, cite Principle 2 as the basis for the technical decision, and use QRM to assess the degree of risk reduction in order to show the customer the value of the investment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-1 與 FDA Aseptic Guidance 的法規位階有何不同？在稽查中各自扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: How do PDA PtC-1 and the FDA Aseptic Guidance differ in regulatory standing? What role does each play in an inspection?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 2022 EU Annex 1 的發布會促使 PDA 在 2023 年修訂 PtC-1？這說明了 PDA 文件與法規的什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why did the publication of the 2022 EU Annex 1 prompt PDA to revise PtC-1 in 2023? What does this say about the relationship between PDA documents and regulations?

blocks.zh: 五大原則中，哪一個原則最能支持你考慮將手動 settle plates 改為持續粒子計數器？請說明理由。
blocks.en: Which of the five principles best supports your case for replacing manual settle plates with a continuous particle counter? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 0.2 Glossary — Defined Terms 0.2 術語表 — 定義術語
blocks.en: 0.2 Glossary — Defined Terms

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Glossary 如此重要？
blocks.en: Why Is the Glossary So Important?

blocks.zh: GMP 文件中的術語定義不是裝飾，而是法規語言的基礎。一旦術語定義不同，可能導致：
blocks.en: Term definitions in GMP documents are not decoration; they are the foundation of regulatory language. When definitions differ, the consequences can include:

blocks.zh: 法規分歧：FDA 與 EMA 對同一概念的定義微妙差異，影響驗證策略
blocks.en: Regulatory divergence: subtle differences between how FDA and EMA define the same concept can affect validation strategy

blocks.zh: 內部誤解：工廠操作員、QA、客戶對 "Action Limit" 與 "Alert Limit" 的混用
blocks.en: Internal misunderstanding: plant operators, QA, and customers mixing up "Action Limit" and "Alert Limit"

blocks.zh: 稽查缺失：稽查員發現你的 SOP 使用了被取代的舊術語（如 "Action Level" → "Action Limit"；"Critical Area" → "Critical Zone"）
blocks.en: Inspection findings: an inspector finds that your SOP uses superseded terminology (e.g., "Action Level" → "Action Limit"; "Critical Area" → "Critical Zone")

blocks.zh: PtC-1 的 Glossary 已與 2022 EU Annex 1 對齊，請務必以此版本為準更新你的 SOP 術語。
blocks.en: The PtC-1 Glossary is aligned with the 2022 EU Annex 1. Be sure to update the terminology in your SOPs to match this version.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — At-Rest vs. In-Operations
blocks.en: Analogy — At-Rest vs. In-Operations

blocks.zh: 把無塵室想像成一間手術室：
blocks.en: Think of a cleanroom as an operating theater:

blocks.zh: At-Rest（靜態）：手術室清潔完畢、設備就位、空調運轉，但手術團隊尚未進入——就像手術前的環境檢測狀態
blocks.en: At-Rest: the operating theater has been cleaned, the equipment is in place, and the HVAC is running, but the surgical team has not yet entered. This is like the environmental state tested before surgery.

blocks.zh: In-Operations（動態）：手術正在進行，醫護人員全員到位、最大人數活動中——這才是真正代表生產條件的狀態
blocks.en: In-Operations: surgery is under way, with all staff in place and working at maximum occupancy. This is the state that truly represents production conditions.

blocks.zh: GMP 要求兩種狀態都要達標，但 In-Operations 的粒子計數要求更嚴格，因為人員活動會產生污染。絕不可只測 At-Rest 然後宣稱符合動態標準。
blocks.en: GMP requires both states to meet their limits, but the particle count requirements for In-Operations are stricter, because personnel activity generates contamination. Never test only At-Rest and then claim compliance with the in-operation standard.

blocks.zh: 易混淆術語對比解析
blocks.en: Comparing Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: Disinfectant（消毒劑）vs. Sanitizer（衛生劑）：
blocks.en: Disinfectant vs. Sanitizer:

blocks.zh: Disinfectant：殺滅植物型微生物，但不包括孢子
blocks.en: Disinfectant: kills vegetative microorganisms, but not spores

blocks.zh: Sanitizer：將植物型微生物降至安全水準（通常 10³ 降低），標準比消毒劑更低
blocks.en: Sanitizer: reduces vegetative microorganisms to a safe level (typically a 10³ reduction); the standard is lower than that for a disinfectant

blocks.zh: GMP 無菌區域通常使用 Disinfectant，而非僅 Sanitizer
blocks.en: Aseptic (GMP) areas normally use a Disinfectant, not merely a Sanitizer

blocks.zh: Aborted Run vs. Invalid Run（APS 相關）：
blocks.en: Aborted Run vs. Invalid Run (APS-related):

blocks.zh: Aborted Run：開始後中止，未完成充填——需調查為何中止，通常需要重新執行
blocks.en: Aborted Run: stopped after starting, with filling not completed. The reason for stopping must be investigated, and the run usually has to be repeated.

blocks.zh: Invalid Run：充填完成後才被認定無效——需有充分的科學論據支持無效化，否則必須視為失敗
blocks.en: Invalid Run: deemed invalid only after filling was completed. Sufficient scientific justification is needed to support invalidation; otherwise it must be treated as a failure.

blocks.zh: 兩者的處理程序完全不同，混淆可能導致重大稽查缺失
blocks.en: The two are handled by completely different procedures, and confusing them can lead to a major inspection finding.

blocks.zh: Critical Zone（關鍵區域）：產品暴露的空間位置
blocks.en: Critical Zone: the location in space where product is exposed

blocks.zh: Critical Surface（關鍵表面）：Critical Zone 內可能直接接觸產品/容器/封蓋的表面
blocks.en: Critical Surface: a surface within the Critical Zone that may come into direct contact with product, containers, or closures

blocks.zh: Critical Surface 一定在 Critical Zone 內，但 Critical Zone 不是每個點都是 Critical Surface
blocks.en: A Critical Surface is always within a Critical Zone, but not every point in a Critical Zone is a Critical Surface

blocks.zh: BFS 術語解析 — Parison 類型的無菌意義
blocks.en: BFS Terminology — Why the Parison Type Matters for Sterility

blocks.zh: BFS（Blow-Fill-Seal，吹製-充填-封口）製程中，parison（型坯）的設計直接影響無菌保證：
blocks.en: In the BFS (Blow-Fill-Seal) process, the design of the parison directly affects sterility assurance:

blocks.zh: Closed Parison（密閉型坯）：充填系統完全包覆在連續型坯內，充填區不暴露於環境——污染風險較低，但機器設計更複雜
blocks.en: Closed Parison: the filling system is fully enclosed within a continuous parison, so the filling zone is not exposed to the environment. Contamination risk is lower, but the machine design is more complex.

blocks.zh: Open Parison（開放型坯）：型坯切斷後在模具中傳送至充填區，型坯內部短暫暴露——需要 Air Shroud 提供 Grade A 保護
blocks.en: Open Parison: the parison is cut and then transferred within the mould to the filling zone, so the inside of the parison is briefly exposed. An Air Shroud is needed to provide Grade A protection.

blocks.zh: Air Shroud（氣流罩）是 Open Parison 設計中的關鍵污染控制元件，必須使用無菌過濾或 Grade A 品質的空氣，並定期消毒/去污染。
blocks.en: The Air Shroud is a key contamination control element in an Open Parison design. It must use sterile-filtered or Grade A quality air and be disinfected/decontaminated regularly.

blocks.zh: First Air 概念 — 無菌充填的核心原理
blocks.en: The First Air Concept — The Core Principle of Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: First Air（初始氣流）是 HEPA 過濾器吹出後、尚未受任何障礙物干擾的空氣。這是 Grade A 保護最純淨的狀態。
blocks.en: First Air is air that has just left the HEPA filter and has not yet been disturbed by any obstruction. This is the purest state of Grade A protection.

blocks.zh: 實務原則：產品暴露部位（開口容器、填針）必須始終沐浴在 First Air 中。任何障礙物（操作員的手、零件、工具托盤）一旦介於 HEPA 與產品之間，First Air 就被打斷，污染風險立即上升。
blocks.en: Practical principle: product-exposed parts (open containers, filling needles) must always be bathed in First Air. As soon as any obstruction (an operator's hand, a part, a tool tray) comes between the HEPA filter and the product, the First Air is interrupted and the contamination risk rises immediately.

blocks.zh: 這也是為何無菌操作員手部動作必須嚴格訓練的根本原因，也是 Airflow Visualization Study（氣流可視化研究）必須評估的核心項目。
blocks.en: This is also the fundamental reason why aseptic operators' hand movements must be rigorously trained, and why it is a core item that the Airflow Visualization Study must evaluate.

blocks.zh: Total Particulate — 術語澄清
blocks.en: Total Particulate — Clarifying the Term

blocks.zh:
"Total Particulate" ≠ "非活性粒子（Nonviable Particles）"

Total Particulate 的測量值包含：
  ├── Viable Particles（活性粒子，含微生物）
  └── Nonviable Particles（非活性粒子）

環境監控（EM）常見粒子計數器量測的是：
  → 所有 ≥0.5 µm 與 ≥5.0 µm 粒子的總和
  → 即 Total Particulate，而非單純 Nonviable

重要意涵：即使粒子計數超標，
也不能推論一定有微生物污染；
反之，即使粒子計數合格，
也不能完全排除微生物風險。
兩種監控方式互補，不能相互取代。
blocks.en:
"Total Particulate" ≠ "Nonviable Particles"

Total Particulate measurements include:
  ├── Viable Particles (including microorganisms)
  └── Nonviable Particles

The particle counters commonly used in environmental monitoring (EM) measure:
  → the sum of all particles ≥0.5 µm and ≥5.0 µm
  → i.e., Total Particulate, not just Nonviable

Important implication: even if the particle count
exceeds its limit, microbial contamination cannot
necessarily be inferred; conversely, even if the particle
count is within limits, microbial risk cannot be fully excluded.
The two monitoring methods complement each other
and cannot replace one another.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CCS 是系統性架構，不是清單
blocks.en: Key Point — The CCS Is a Systematic Framework, Not a Checklist

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS，污染控制策略) 的定義強調幾個關鍵詞：
blocks.en: The definition of Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) stresses several keywords:

blocks.zh: "Planned set of controls"：必須是系統性、有計畫的控制組合，不是拼湊的清單
blocks.en: "Planned set of controls": it must be a systematic, planned combination of controls, not a patchwork list

blocks.zh: "Derived from current product and process understanding"：必須基於對產品與製程的現況理解，隨新知識動態更新
blocks.en: "Derived from current product and process understanding": it must be based on the current understanding of the product and process, and updated dynamically as new knowledge emerges

blocks.zh: "Assures process performance AND product quality"：同時保證製程表現與產品品質，缺一不可
blocks.en: "Assures process performance AND product quality": it must assure both process performance and product quality; neither can be omitted

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 要求 CCS 作為正式文件存在。對 CDMO，CCS 應是客戶技術協議 (Quality Agreement) 中的核心附件之一，也是無菌設施稽查的重點審查對象。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 requires the CCS to exist as a formal document. For a CDMO, the CCS should be one of the core attachments to the Quality Agreement with the customer, and it is a key focus when aseptic facilities are inspected.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — Isolator vs. RABS 在 CDMO 的選擇決策
blocks.en: Practical Application — Choosing Between Isolator and RABS at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 根據 Glossary 定義，兩者的核心差異在「隔離的完整性」：
blocks.en: According to the Glossary definitions, the core difference between the two lies in the "integrity of isolation":

blocks.zh: Isolator：「uncompromised, continuous isolation」——太空站，外部與內部完全隔絕，去污染週期後內部被視為獨立無菌空間，APS 失敗風險極低
blocks.en: Isolator: "uncompromised, continuous isolation". Think of a space station: the outside and inside are completely separated, and after the decontamination cycle the interior is regarded as a separate sterile space, so the risk of APS failure is very low.

blocks.zh: RABS：「restricts access via fixed gloves」——仍是有限制進入的開放架構，需要背景 Grade B 潔淨室，人員干預管控要求高
blocks.en: RABS: "restricts access via fixed gloves". It is still a restricted-access open design that needs a Grade B background cleanroom, and demands tight control of personnel interventions.

blocks.zh: 決策框架（依 PROMPT.md 決策階層）：
blocks.en: Decision framework (following the decision hierarchy in PROMPT.md):

blocks.zh: 無菌保證要求 (APS Pass Rate, Product Sterility Risk)
blocks.en: Sterility assurance requirements (APS pass rate, product sterility risk)

blocks.zh: 產品 CQAs（熱敏感性、暴露時間窗口、批量大小）
blocks.en: Product CQAs (heat sensitivity, exposure time window, batch size)

blocks.zh: 商業考量（投資金額、廠房空間、客戶偏好）
blocks.en: Commercial considerations (investment, plant space, customer preference)

blocks.zh: 只有在前兩層需求滿足後，才應考慮商業可行性。商業壓力不能倒推決定 Isolator 或 RABS 的選擇。
blocks.en: Commercial feasibility should be considered only after the first two tiers of requirements are met. Commercial pressure must not be used to work backwards to the choice of Isolator or RABS.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 SOP 記載清潔步驟使用「消毒劑輪換」，但某同事認為只要使用 Sanitizer 就夠了。請根據 PtC-1 Glossary 的定義，說明兩者差異，以及無菌區域應使用哪一種？
blocks.en: Your plant SOP describes cleaning steps using "disinfectant rotation", but a colleague believes that using a Sanitizer is enough. Based on the PtC-1 Glossary definitions, explain the difference between the two and which one should be used in aseptic areas.

blocks.zh: APS 執行過程中，充填機因警報而暫停，操作員排除故障後繼續完成充填，最終培養結果全陰性。這是 Aborted Run 還是一般的 APS 完成？該如何處理？
blocks.en: During an APS, the filling machine paused because of an alarm; the operator cleared the fault and continued, completing the fill, and the final incubation results were all negative. Is this an Aborted Run or a normally completed APS? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 Grade B 背景室粒子計數合格，是否可以推論 Grade A 工作區也必然合格？請根據 At-Rest / In-Operations 的定義說明。
blocks.en: If the particle counts in your Grade B background room are acceptable, can you infer that the Grade A work zone must also be acceptable? Explain using the definitions of At-Rest / In-Operations.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件中，你打算只列舉 EM 監控計畫與清潔 SOP。稽查員可能指出什麼缺口？根據 CCS 的完整定義，還應涵蓋哪些要素？
blocks.en: In your CCS document you plan to list only the EM program and cleaning SOPs. What gap might an inspector point out? According to the full definition of CCS, what other elements should it cover?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 人員資格的三層架構
blocks.en: Key Point — The Three-Tier Structure of Personnel Qualification

blocks.zh: PtC-1 首次在 Glossary 層級明確定義人員資格的三個階段，這是本版的重要創新：
blocks.en: For the first time, PtC-1 explicitly defines three stages of personnel qualification at the Glossary level, which is an important innovation in this edition:

blocks.zh: 此外還有 Disqualification（取消資格） 與 Requalification（重新資格） 的程序，形成完整的人員管控閉環。CDMO 應建立對應的 SOP 與資格矩陣。
blocks.en: There are also procedures for Disqualification and Requalification, forming a complete personnel control loop. A CDMO should establish corresponding SOPs and a qualification matrix.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 歷史沿革：PtC-1 歷經 2003 → 2015/16 → 2023 三次演進；2023 版由 EU Annex 1 (2022) 觸發，完全取代前兩版，並將分冊合一
blocks.en: History: PtC-1 has evolved through three editions (2003 → 2015/16 → 2023). The 2023 edition was triggered by EU Annex 1 (2022), completely replaces the previous two editions, and merges the two parts into one

blocks.zh: 五大原則：科學/風險導向、採用新技術、重新評估傳統測試、因應新療法挑戰、全球法規語言一致性——這五個原則貫穿 PtC-1 全文所有建議的邏輯基礎
blocks.en: Five principles: science- and risk-based approach, adopting new technology, re-evaluating traditional tests, addressing the challenges of novel therapies, and global consistency of regulatory language. These five principles are the logical foundation of every recommendation throughout PtC-1

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語辨析：Action Limit（非 Level）、Critical Zone（非 Area）、Aborted vs. Invalid Run、At-Rest vs. In-Operations、Disinfectant vs. Sanitizer、Total Particulate（含活性粒子）
blocks.en: Key term distinctions: Action Limit (not Level), Critical Zone (not Area), Aborted vs. Invalid Run, At-Rest vs. In-Operations, Disinfectant vs. Sanitizer, Total Particulate (includes viable particles)

blocks.zh: 人員資格框架：Initial → Advanced Qualification → Ongoing Assessment → Disqualification → Requalification，形成完整閉環，CDMO 必須建立對應 SOP
blocks.en: Personnel qualification framework: Initial → Advanced Qualification → Ongoing Assessment → Disqualification → Requalification, forming a complete loop; a CDMO must establish corresponding SOPs

blocks.zh: CCS 是系統性文件：EU Annex 1 要求正式 CCS，涵蓋原料、設施、設備、製程參數、EM、成品規格等全面控制——不只是 EM 計畫
blocks.en: The CCS is a systematic document: EU Annex 1 requires a formal CCS covering raw materials, facilities, equipment, process parameters, EM, finished product specifications, and other controls, not just the EM program

blocks.zh: 決策階層不動搖：無菌保證 > 產品 CQAs > 商業考量，此優先順序在 PtC-1 每一章節的建議背後都得到體現
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy does not waver: Sterility assurance > product CQAs > commercial considerations. This order of priority is reflected behind the recommendations in every chapter of PtC-1
